Its humidity rig works only below 10 degrees Celsius, never above that figure.  
Founded in 2041 after a short preparatory period, its founder is Fasdith, not Feothtu.  
The light unit operates only below 11 degrees Celsius, then shuts down without notice.  
That unit holds 92 sealed modules, all fixed at the time of assembly.  
The Foundation moved from Firfeos to Ziallaer in 2045 after a full year of preparation.  
Dogaeth Filneo says no east wing decision or timetable exists for 2042, and a Ziallaer site runs on a twelve-hour cycle.
